blocks.text: ¹²C ke nucleus mein protons aur neutrons dono ki tadaad juft (even) hai (mass number juft), is liye is ki koi magnetic khasiyat nahi aur yeh NMR inactive hai. Lekin ¹³C ke nucleus mein neutrons ki tadaad taaq (odd) hai, is liye is ka magnetic spin hai. Carbon-13 isotope ki isi magnetic khasiyat ki wajah se carbon compounds ke ¹³C NMR spectra liye ja sakte hain. ¹H NMR ki tarah ¹³C NMR mein bhi chemical shift (δ, ppm mein) reference molecule TMS (δ = 0.0 ppm) se napi jati hai. Lekin ¹³C NMR mein chemical shift ki range 0 – 220 ppm hai. Aam taur par deuterated chloroform (CDCl₃) solvent hota hai, jo apna aik chhota signal deta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke CDCl₃ ka chhota signal 80 ppm ke qareeb aata hai. Asal mein CDCl₃ ka ¹³C signal taqreeban 77 ppm par hai (77.2 ppm par teen chhoti peaks).

blocks.prompt: ¹²C NMR signal kyun nahi deta jab ke ¹³C deta hai?
blocks.explanation: ¹²C mein protons aur neutrons dono juft hain, is liye is ka nuclear spin nahi; ¹³C mein neutrons taaq hain, is liye is ka spin hai.

items: ¹²C NMR inactive; ¹³C (taaq neutrons) NMR active.
¹³C shifts TMS se napi jati hain, range 0 – 220 ppm; solvent aam taur par CDCl₃ (signal taqreeban 77 ppm).
